hero.title: From case file to legal argument, everything stays tied to its source
hero.subtitle: Open judgments, contracts and statutes beside your notes. Capture a passage and Legal Masr keeps the document and page with it, so you can get back to the evidence in seconds.
hero.note: No account required. Your case files don't need to leave your computer.

mock.sourceText: The contract terminates upon thirty days' written notice.
mock.commentaryText: The notice must be in writing. Check whether email qualifies as written notice in this case.

features.title: Tools built around the way you work
features.lead: Instead of keeping quotes, notes and questions in one file, keep each piece where it belongs and connect it to the source behind it.

items.title: Keep the text separate from your opinion
items.desc: Keep the law, judgment or source text exactly as it appears, then write your interpretation or notes separately. When you come back later, you can tell what came from the document and what you concluded yourself.

items.title: Read PDFs and capture the evidence
items.desc: Open a judgment, contract or statute beside your notes. Select the passage you need or capture part of the page as an image, and Legal Masr keeps it linked to the document and page.

items.title: Connect every argument to its evidence
items.desc: When you write an argument, link it to the texts and notes you rely on. When you need to verify it, jump back to the source instead of searching through your files again.

items.title: Turn recordings into searchable notes
items.desc: Record a note or attach an audio file and transcribe it on your device with Whisper. If you need cloud transcription, you can choose it yourself instead of sending recordings automatically.

items.title: Find the information instead of searching through files
items.desc: Search your case notebooks, pages and notes instantly. Once you capture text from a PDF, you can search that text too, without opening the file and looking through it manually.

items.title: Export your work and keep a copy
items.desc: When you're done, export your notes as Markdown or PDF, or export the entire library as JSON. You can also create a complete backup of your research and restore it when you need it.

guide.title: From reading the file to preparing your argument
guide.lead: Your daily workflow: open, capture, analyze and connect.

steps.title: Create a notebook for the case
steps.desc: Create a separate notebook for each case and organize it into pages for issues, facts, arguments, legal texts or whatever structure works for you.

steps.title: Add the case documents
steps.desc: Import the judgments, contracts, statutes and PDF files you need to refer to during your research.

steps.title: Capture the important passages
steps.desc: As you read, capture any text you may rely on. The passage is saved with the document name and page number so you can return to it later.

steps.title: Write your analysis and questions
steps.desc: Write your interpretation, record questions that need further review, and connect each note to the evidence supporting it.

steps.title: Prepare and export your work
steps.desc: When your research is ready, export your notes or case as PDF or Markdown, or keep a complete backup of your library.

local.title: Your case files don't need to leave your computer
local.desc: Legal Masr is designed so you can work on your research and files locally. Your notebooks, PDFs and recordings stay on your computer, with no account or required sync. Any cloud service is used only when you choose it.
points: Work without an account or sign-in
Your files and notebooks are stored locally on your computer
Whisper can transcribe recordings locally after the model is downloaded
Cloud transcription is optional and never happens automatically

saas.title: What's next? A cloud version that keeps your work with you
saas.desc: The current desktop app is built for solo lawyers working from their own computer. In Q1 2027, we'll add a SaaS version that lets you access your notebooks from multiple devices and work with your team.
points: Access your notebooks from multiple devices
Designed to grow from solo practice to a team
The desktop app will remain available for those who prefer local work

download.title: All Your Notebooks in One Place
download.desc: Try Legal Masr and easily organize your notebooks and notes.
download.note: This is an early preview, and automatic updates aren't available yet. We recommend keeping a backup of your important notebooks while trying the app.
